sloka: बुद्धिप्रधानान् रुचिराभिधानान् ।सम्श्रद्दधानान् जगतः प्रधानान् ।नानाविधानान् रुचिराभिधानान् ।ददर्श तस्याम् पुरि यातुधानान् ॥५-५-१५॥
transliteration: buddhipradhānān rucirābhidhānān ।samśraddadhānān jagataḥ pradhānān ।nānāvidhānān rucirābhidhānān ।dadarśa tasyām puri yātudhānān ॥5-5-15॥

translations.english: He saw there in the city of Lanka, demons, who were intellectuals, pleasing in words, with faith in religion, preeminent heroes of the world of different kinds, followers of good practices and with lovely names.
